text: {"verifiable":true,"metric":"three_year_average_unadjusted_ebitda_margin","formula":"(((operating_income_FY2018 + depreciation_amortization_FY2018) / revenue_FY2018) + ((operating_income_FY2019 + depreciation_amortization_FY2019) / revenue_FY2019) + ((operating_income_FY2020 + depreciation_amortization_FY2020) / revenue_FY2020)) / 3 * 100","roles":[{"name":"operating_income_FY2018","aliases":["Operating income"],"period":"FY2018"},{"name":"depreciation_amortization_FY2018","aliases":["Depreciation and amortization"],"period":"FY2018"},{"name":"revenue_FY2018","aliases":["Total revenues"],"period":"FY2018"},{"name":"operating_income_FY2019","aliases":["Operating income"],"period":"FY2019"},{"name":"depreciation_amortization_FY2019","aliases":["Depreciation and amortization"],"period":"FY2019"},{"name":"revenue_FY2019","aliases":["Total revenues"],"period":"FY2019"},{"name":"operating_income_FY2020","aliases":["Operating income"],"period":"FY2020"},{"name":"depreciation_amortization_FY2020","aliases":["Depreciation and amortization"],"period":"FY2020"},{"name":"revenue_FY2020","aliases":["Total revenues"],"period":"FY2020"}],"claim_unit":"percent","formula_source":"policy_registry"}
